# About this item

* High-Impact Football Action – Each month features bold and dynamic scenes of athletes making game-winning plays—perfect for fans who love the intensity of the gridiron
* Premium Silk Paper Printing – Printed on thick, high-quality silk paper with vibrant, fade-resistant colors and a smooth matte finish built to last all season long
* Multiple Sizes & Formats Available – Choose from Classic Top-Fold, Classic Mid-Fold, Modern Top-Fold, and Notes Mid-Fold layouts to fit bedrooms, offices, dorms, or locker rooms
* Holiday and writing space options – Includes all major USA and Canada holidays with a Sunday-start week format for easy planning. Classic layout features date blocks sized for brief daily notes and appointments, the Modern layout is focused on showcasing the artwork, and the Notes style adds a Notes column for extra lists and reminders.
* Perfect Gift for Football Fans – A great present for players, coaches, fantasy football enthusiasts, or any sports lover who wants a powerful and practical calendar
* Five Size Options (Display Size — Width × Height): Compact (8.5″ × 11″), Slim (5.5″ × 16.5″), Medium (8.5″ × 17″), and Large (11″ × 16.5″ or 11″ × 17″) — each format offers a unique layout to fit your wall space and planning style.
